business_summary: YYForce Inc., operates as a data and technology-driven company offering AI-enabled workforce management and integrated facility management (IFM) solutions in Singapore, Malaysia, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company's workforce management segment operates through the YY Circle platform, which provides workforce planning, scheduling, deployment, and operational optimization solutions for clients in the hospitality, food and beverage, retail, and other service-oriented industries. The platform utilizes data analytics and artificial intelligence capabilities to support labor forecasting and workforce allocation. The company's integrated facility management segment operates through its 24IFM software platform and related subsidiaries, providing facility management and operational support services across sectors, including hospitality, transportation, banking, retail, and mixed-use commercial properties. It offers workforce coordination, operational maintenance support, and facility-related management solutions. It offers the YY Smart iClean App, a smart toilet central management platform. It offers cleaning services that include commercial cleaning for offices and schools; hospitality cleaning for hotels and shopping centers; industrial cleaning, facade cleaning, disinfection, and stewarding services for meetings, incentives, conferences, and exhibitions, as well as banquets; and pest control services. It also provides cleaning robots and machines. It also offers IT consultancy and development of software and applications; residential, commercial, and industrial real estate management services; private security; and hospitality services. It also retails and distributes gaming peripherals and accessories. The company was formerly known as YY Group Holding Limited and changed its name to YYForce Inc. in September 2026. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Singapore.
business_summary_ko: YYForce Inc.는 싱가포르, 말레이시아, 영국, 네덜란드 및 전 세계에서 AI 지원 인력 관리 및 통합 시설 관리(IFM) 솔루션을 제공하는 데이터 및 기술 중심 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 회사의 인력 관리 부문은 숙박, 식음료, 소매 및 기타 서비스 지향 산업의 고객을 위한 인력 계획, 일정 관리, 배포 및 운영 최적화 솔루션을 제공하는 YY Circle 플랫폼을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 플랫폼은 데이터 분석 및 인공 지능 기능을 활용하여 인력 예측 및 인력 할당을 지원합니다. 회사의 통합 시설 관리 부문은 24IFM 소프트웨어 플랫폼 및 관련 자회사를 통해 운영되며 숙박업, 운송, 은행, 소매 및 복합 상업용 부동산을 포함한 부문 전반에 걸쳐 시설 관리 및 운영 지원 서비스를 제공합니다. 인력 조정, 운영 유지 관리 지원, 시설 관련 관리 솔루션을 제공합니다. 스마트 화장실 중앙관리 플랫폼인 YY Smart iClean App을 제공합니다. 상업용 청소를 포함한 청소 서비스를 제공합니다.
